headlines.title: Is Netflix (NFLX) Worth More Than Its Cash Flow Suggests?
headlines.summary: Netflix has seen its share price fall sharply over the past year, yet over a three year window the stock is still well ahead of where it was. This puts fresh focus on whether that journey lines up with the cash the business can generate. With investors weighing recent news on engagement, advertising and content spending, the live question is whether today’s valuation is grounded in the company’s underlying cash flows rather than just sentiment around streaming.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
